dct_title_s: Geodata of Damage Assessment in Atatra, Gaza Strip - Occupied Palestinian Territory
dct_description_sm: This map illustrates satellite-detected damage and destruction in the Atatra area, Gaza Strip, resulting from ongoing violence in the area. Using a satellite image collected 25 July 2014 by the Pleiades satellite, and compared with a pre-crisis Pleiades image collected 6 July 2014, UNOSAT analysis has identified 192 destroyed structures, 60 severely damaged structures, and 89 moderately damaged structures. In addition, 108 craters on roads and in agricultural and non-urbanized areas are also visible as of 25 July 2014. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to UNITAR/UNOSAT.
